data: Amazon reported a **net loss of $2.722 billion in fiscal 2022**, driven largely by a $12.7 billion pre-tax valuation loss on its Rivian stake. It reported **net income of $59.248 billion in fiscal 2024**. That is a swing of about $61.97 billion. Because the 2022 starting figure is negative, a conventional percentage change isn't really meaningful. If you measure the swing against the absolute size of the 2022 loss, the improvement works out to roughly **2,277%**. A clearer way to put it is that Amazon went from a $2.7 billion loss to a $59.2 billion profit. For context, fiscal 2023 net income of $30.425 billion means 2024 profit roughly doubled again, up about 95% year over year.
